BMS Building Materials Suisse ist ein Grosshändler für Baumaterial im Rohbau und Innenausbau. Zu unserer Unternehmensgruppe gehören die namhaften Spezialisten Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton und RegusciReco . Unsere erfahrenen Fachleute beraten, unterstützen und inspirieren mit grossem Engagement Kunden aus der Bauwirtschaft sowie Privatkunden an rund 110 Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Nahe am Baualltag sind wir der lokale und verlässliche Partner für jedes Bauprojekt. Schnell, einfach und kompetent.
Deine Leidenschaft für den Rohbau trifft auf Führungskompetenz?
Dann bist du bei uns richtig!
Wir suchen per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine*n motivierte*n und erfahrene*n Teamleiter*in für unseren Baubedarf - Shop in Gebenstorf .
Bei uns dreht sich alles um hochwertige Materialien, starke Partnerschaften und exzellenten Service. Wenn du nicht nur ein Händchen für Rohbauprodukte, sondern auch für Teamführung hast und die tägliche Herausforderung in einem dynamischen Umfeld liebst, dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

Verantwortung über die Lagerbewirtschaftung, Lagerbestände und Inventur-Abschluss
Umsetzung von verschiedenen Verkaufsförderungsmassnahmen, Aktionen und Promotionen
Erstellung und Nachbearbeitung von Offerten, Abhol-, Liefer- und Retourenscheine
Abwicklungen der Warenein- und ausgängen sowie Kontrolle der Lieferscheine

BMS Building Materials Suisse è un grossista di materiali di costruzione strutturali e interni. Il nostro gruppo di aziende comprende i rinomati specialisti Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton e RegusciReco. I nostri esperti consigliano, supportano e ispirano i clienti del settore edile e i clienti privati in circa 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. Vicino alla costruzione quotidiana, siamo il partner locale e affidabile per ogni progetto di costruzione. Veloce, facile e competente.
La vostra passione per la costruzione di conchiglie incontra la competenza di leadership?
Allora hai ragione con noi!
Siamo alla ricerca di un team leader motivato ed esperto per le nostre esigenze di costruzione - negozio a Gibstorf dal 1 ottobre 2026 o d'accordo.
Siamo tutti su materiali di alta qualità, partnership forti e servizio eccellente. Se non solo avete un aggancio per i prodotti per la costruzione di conchiglie, ma anche per la leadership di squadra e per amare la sfida quotidiana in un ambiente dinamico, allora non vediamo l'ora di voi!
Responsabilità complessiva per il Handwerkerzentrum e il suo sviluppo aziendale
Responsabilità degli obiettivi di vendita e di margine del luogo
Consulenza tecnica e di vendita ai clienti
leadership professionale e organizzativa di un team di quattro e responsabilità per il loro sviluppo
Responsabilità per la gestione delle scorte, le scorte e la chiusura dell'inventario
Attuazione di varie misure di promozione delle vendite, promozioni e promozioni
Preparazione e post-elaborazione di offerte, raccolta, consegna e reso note
Gestione e controllo delle note di consegna
Persona di contatto diretta per i nostri clienti pick-up
Se il tuo cuore batte più velocemente nell'area di attività sopra descritta e hai le seguenti esperienze e competenze, sei il nostro candidato desiderato:
Formazione professionale completata e diversi anni di esperienza nel settore dell'edilizia, idealmente nel commercio edilizia
Conoscenza approfondita dell'ingegneria strutturale
Prima esperienza di gestione in una posizione paragonabile
Grande passione per le vendite e la consulenza, idealmente con una rete esistente nella regione
Alta motivazione e guidare per spostare il business in avanti
Metodi di lavoro autonomi e strutturati
Buona reputazione
Buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura
un lavoro impegnativo, versatile e interessante in un buon ambiente di lavoro in cui la cooperazione attiva e il lavoro autonomo sono sottolineati
formazione intensiva è un programma, per cui i nostri nuovi colleghi possono beneficiare di formazione di prodotto e di sistema all'interno dell'azienda
Sostegno ai nostri dipendenti nel loro sviluppo professionale e personale
Nessun turno e uso del fine settimana
Quota salariale base lorda x 13 plus
Informazioni sulla posizione clicca qui
5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane da 50 anni) e shopping fino a max. 10 giorni, benefici aggiuntivi come un fondo pensione indipendente eccellentemente finanziato e sconti sulla nostra gamma completa di prodotti e benefici premium esterni

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of structural and interior construction materials. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Your passion for shell construction meets leadership competence?
Then you are right with us!
We are looking for a motivated and experienced team leader for our construction needs - shop in Gibstorf as of 1 October 2026 or by agreement.
We are all about high-quality materials, strong partnerships and excellent service. If you not only have a knack for shell construction products, but also for team leadership and love the daily challenge in a dynamic environment, then we look forward to you!
Overall responsibility for the Handwerkerzentrum and its business development
Responsibility of the sales and margin targets of the location
Technical and sales advice to customers
Professional and organizational leadership of a team of four as well as responsibility for their development
Responsibility for stock management, stockpiles and inventory closure
Implementation of various sales promotion measures, promotions and promotions
Preparation and post-processing of offers, collection, delivery and returns notes
Entry and exit handling and control of delivery notes
Direct contact person for our pick-up customers
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you have the following experiences and competencies, you are our desired candidate:
Completed vocational training and several years of experience in the construction industry, ideally in the construction trade
In-depth knowledge in structural engineering
First management experience in a comparable position
Great passion for sales and consulting, ideally with an existing network in the region
High motivation and drive to move the business forward
Self-employed and structured working methods
Good repute
Good knowledge of German in words and writing
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company
Support of our employees in their professional and personal development
No shift and weekend use
Basic wage gross x 13 plus variable wage share
Location information click here
5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from 50 years of age) and holiday shopping up to max. 10 days, additional benefits such as an excellently financed independent pension fund and discounts on our complete product range as well as external premium benefits
We look forward to your complete application documents in electronic form.
Want to know more about us? Now visit our career page at jobs.bmsuisse.ch.
We are happy to answer your questions at jobs@bmsuisse.ch.
For data protection reasons, initiative applications and e-applications via email and/or postal mail are no longer considered.
You can become an employee anywhere. We are looking for influencers.

BMS Building Materials Suisse est grossiste en matériaux de construction structurale et intérieure. Notre groupe d'entreprises comprend les spécialistes renommés Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton et RegusciReco. Nos experts expérimentés conseillent, supportent et inspirent les clients de l'industrie de la construction ainsi que les clients privés dans environ 110 endroits en Suisse. Proche de la construction quotidienne, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour chaque projet de construction. Rapide, facile et compétente.
Votre passion pour la construction de coquillages répond aux compétences de leadership ?
Alors tu as raison avec nous !
Nous recherchons un chef d'équipe motivé et expérimenté pour nos besoins de construction - magasin à Gibstorf au 1er octobre 2026 ou par accord.
Nous parlons de matériaux de haute qualité, de solides partenariats et d'un excellent service. Si vous avez non seulement un knack pour les produits de construction en coque, mais aussi pour le leadership d'équipe et aimez le défi quotidien dans un environnement dynamique, alors nous nous réjouissons de vous!
La responsabilité globale du Handwerkerzentrum et son développement
Responsabilité des ventes et des objectifs de marge du lieu
Conseils techniques et commerciaux aux clients
Leadership professionnel et organisationnel d'une équipe de quatre personnes et responsabilité de leur développement
Responsabilité de la gestion des stocks, des stocks et de la clôture des stocks
Mise en œuvre de diverses mesures de promotion des ventes, promotions et promotions
Préparation et post-traitement des offres, collecte, livraison et retours
Gestion et contrôle de l'entrée et de la sortie des notes de livraison
Personne de contact directe pour nos clients
Si votre cœur bat plus vite dans le domaine de travail décrit ci-dessus et que vous avez les expériences et les compétences suivantes, vous êtes notre candidat désiré:
Formation professionnelle complète et plusieurs années d'expérience dans le secteur de la construction, idéalement dans le secteur de la construction
Connaissance approfondie en ingénierie structurelle
Première expérience de gestion dans un poste comparable
Grande passion pour la vente et le conseil, idéalement avec un réseau existant dans la région
Haute motivation et volonté de faire avancer l'entreprise
Méthodes de travail indépendantes et structurées
Bonne réputation
Bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture
un emploi stimulant, polyvalent et intéressant dans un bon environnement de travail où la coopération active et le travail indépendant sont soulignés
la formation intensive est un programme qui permet à nos nouveaux collègues de bénéficier de la formation produit et système au sein de l'entreprise
Soutien de nos employés dans leur développement professionnel et personnel

Siamo aggiornati sugli sviluppi del settore edilizio e ciò fa di noi un partner affidabile per ogni progetto di costruzione. Veloci, semplici e competenti.

Che cosa stai aspettando? Diventa parte del nostro team e porta la tua energia e competenza nel nostro punto vendita.
 Entrata dal 1° ottobre 2026 o data da concordare

Per rinforzare il nostro team di Bellinzona, siamo alla ricerca di un(a):
Compiti e responsabilità
In qualità di consulente clienti nel nostro punto vendita di materiali da costruzione in via San Gottardo 98 a Bellinzona , sei il punto di riferimento stabile, strutturato e affidabile per la nostra clientela e all'interno dell'azienda. Garantirai la complementarietà operativa con i colleghi del reparto esterno, assicurando continuità, precisione e coordinazione nell'intero processo commerciale.
Le tue responsabilità includono:
Gestione clienti: supporto tecnico-commerciale, elaborazione di ordini e offerte, consulenza sui prodotti.
Collaborazione operativa e supporto strutturato ai consulenti di vendita esterni: fungere da referente interno che garantisce continuità, preparazione e copertura nelle attività commerciali, assicurando processi fluidi e puntuali.

gehören die namhaften Spezialisten Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton und RegusciReco .

Privatkunden an 110 Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Nahe am Baualltag sind wir der lokale und verlässliche Partner für
jedes Bauprojekt. Schnell, einfach und kompetent.

Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale, denkst vernetzt und bringst Ideen erfolgreich in die Umsetzung? Du möchtest mit innovativen Lösungen die Digitalisierung vorantreiben und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Menschen, Prozessen und Technologien stärken? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir per 1. September oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Project Manager Digitalisation.
In dieser vielseitigen Funktion stärkst du unsere Organisation durch die Entwicklung, Implementierung und Optimierung von technischen sowie prozessualen Lösungen. Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, Effizienzsteigerungen zu erzielen, nachhaltige Verbesserungen umzusetzen und das weitere Unternehmenswachstum zu unterstützen.
Du analysierst die Anforderungen aus dem Business, strukturierst und priorisierst sie und stellst sicher, dass sie zur Unternehmensstrategie passen.
Gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen und externen Partnern entwickelst du praxistaugliche Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.
Du leitest Projekte und Teilprojekte zur Weiterentwicklung und Digitalisierung unserer Geschäftsprozesse – von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale, bringst Verbesserungen auf den Weg und begleitest Veränderungen aktiv.
Du baust dir ein Netzwerk mit Branchenexpertinnen und -experten auf und pflegst dieses, damit du Trends und Innovationen frühzeitig erkennst.

Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Projektarbeit, Projektleitung oder im Innovationsmanagement mit.
Du verfügst über eine Weiterbildung oder höhere Berufsbildung im Projektmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
Du hast fundierte IT-Kenntnisse, die über die gängigen Office-Anwendungen hinausgehen.
Du denkst analytisch, gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an und behältst auch bei komplexen Fragestellungen den Überblick.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbständig und zielorientiert.
Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend und schaffst es, unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen mitzunehmen und für neue Ideen zu begeistern.
Teamarbeit macht dir Freude und du arbeitest gerne bereichsübergreifend mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen.
Auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen handelst du konstruktiv, lösungsorientiert und gehst Konflikte professionell an.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Französischkenntnisse. Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
Du arbeitest agil und eigenverantwortlich und bringst die Bereitschaft mit, innerhalb der Schweiz zu reisen.

BMS Building Materials Suisse è un grossista di materiali da costruzione per la costruzione di conchiglie e la costruzione di interni. Al nostro gruppo di aziende
Sono inclusi i rinomati specialisti Construction Needs, Richner, Gétaz Miauton e RegusciReco.
I nostri esperti consigliano, sostengono e ispirano i clienti del settore edilizio con grande impegno e
Clienti privati in 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. Vicino alla costruzione quotidiana, siamo il partner locale e affidabile per
qualsiasi progetto di costruzione. Veloce, facile e competente.

Riconosce il potenziale di ottimizzazione, pensa in modo in rete e implementa con successo idee? Vuoi utilizzare soluzioni innovative per promuovere la digitalizzazione e rafforzare la cooperazione tra persone, processi e tecnologie? Allora hai ragione con noi.
Al fine di rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata come Project Manager Digitalization entro il 1 settembre o per accordo.
In questa funzione versatile, si rafforza la nostra organizzazione sviluppando, implementando e ottimizzando soluzioni tecniche e di processo. Contribuisci attivamente al raggiungimento dei guadagni di efficienza, all'implementazione di miglioramenti sostenibili e al sostegno di una crescita aziendale ulteriore.
Analizzi i requisiti dal business, struttura e li priorità e assicurarsi che si adattano alla strategia aziendale.
Insieme ai nostri settori specializzati e partner esterni, svilupperai soluzioni pratiche che creino un valore aggiunto reale.
Conduci progetti e sottoprogetti per l'ulteriore sviluppo e digitalizzazione dei nostri processi aziendali, dall'idea alla riuscita dell'implementazione.
Riconoscete il potenziale di ottimizzazione, iniziate i miglioramenti e accompagnate attivamente i cambiamenti.
Costruisci una rete con esperti del settore e lo mantieni in modo da poter identificare tendenze e innovazioni in una fase iniziale.
Pianifica e organizza corsi di formazione per i nostri dipendenti, effettuali e sviluppa continuamente contenuti di apprendimento digitale e materiali di formazione.
Definite i KPI rilevanti, tenete d'occhio il loro sviluppo e ne ricavate informazioni per misurare il successo dei progetti e delle innovazioni.
L'utente fornisce report periodici per la trasparenza sull'uso, i costi, gli investimenti e il valore aggiunto raggiunto.
Se il tuo cuore batte più velocemente nell'area di attività sopra descritta e porti le seguenti abilità, sei il nostro candidato desiderato in:
Porti diversi anni di esperienza nel lavoro di progetto, nella gestione del progetto o nella gestione dell'innovazione.
Ha un'ulteriore formazione o una formazione professionale superiore nella gestione del progetto o in un campo di studio comparabile.
Hai una conoscenza IT approfondita che va oltre le applicazioni di ufficio comuni.
Pensi analiticamente, affrontare le sfide in modo orientato alla soluzione e tenere traccia di problemi complessi.
Lavori strutturati, indipendenti e orientati agli obiettivi.
Comunichi in modo chiaro e convincente e riuscirai a prendere diversi stakeholder e a ispirare nuove idee.
Il lavoro di squadra ti rende felice e ti piace lavorare insieme a persone diverse in diverse aree.
Anche in situazioni difficili, si agisce in modo costruttivo, orientato alla soluzione e affrontare i conflitti professionalmente.
Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e del francese. Le abilità inglesi sono un vantaggio.
Lavorate agile e di vostra responsabilità e portate la volontà di viaggiare in Svizzera.
un business car che può essere utilizzato anche in un ambiente privato
Lavoro ibrido in tutta la Svizzera da tutte le sedi BMS
l'opportunità di vivere la propria creatività in un piccolo team
un lavoro impegnativo, versatile e interessante in un buon ambiente di lavoro in cui la cooperazione attiva e il lavoro autonomo sono sottolineati
La formazione intensiva è un programma, per cui i nostri nuovi colleghi possono beneficiare della formazione di prodotto e di sistema all'interno dell'azienda
Sostenere i nostri dipendenti nel loro sviluppo professionale e personale
5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane da 50 anni) e shopping fino a max. 10 giorni, benefici aggiuntivi come un fondo pensione indipendente eccellentemente finanziato e sconti sulla nostra gamma completa di prodotti e benefici premium esterni
Attendiamo con ansia i vostri documenti applicativi completi in forma elettronica.
Vuoi saperne di più su di noi? Ora visita la nostra pagina di carriera a job.bmsuisse.ch.
Siamo lieti di rispondere alle vostre domande all'indirizzo job@bmsuisse.ch.
Per motivi di protezione dei dati, applicazioni di iniziativa e applicazioni via e-mail e/o posta non sono più considerati.
Puoi diventare un dipendente ovunque. Stiamo cercando degli influencer.

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. To our group of companies
Included are the renowned specialists Construction Needs, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco.
Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry with great commitment as well as
Private customers at 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for
any building project. Quick, easy and competent.

You recognize optimization potential, think in a networked way and successfully implement ideas? Do you want to use innovative solutions to advance digitalization and strengthen cooperation between people, processes and technologies? Then you are exactly right with us.
In order to strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed personality as Project Manager Digitalisation by 1 September or by agreement.
In this versatile function, you strengthen our organization by developing, implementing and optimizing technical and process solutions. You actively contribute to achieving efficiency gains, implementing sustainable improvements and supporting further business growth.
You analyze the requirements from the business, structure and prioritize them and make sure they fit the company strategy.
Together with our specialist areas and external partners, you will develop practical solutions that create real added value.
You lead projects and sub-projects for the further development and digitalization of our business processes – from the idea to the successful implementation.
You recognize potential for optimization, initiate improvements and actively accompany changes.
You build up a network with industry experts and maintain it so that you can identify trends and innovations at an early stage.
You plan and organize trainings for our employees, carry them out and continuously develop digital learning content and training materials.
You define relevant KPIs, keep an eye on their development and derive insights from them for measuring the success of projects and innovations.
You provide regular reporting for transparency about use, costs, investments and the added value achieved.
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following skills, you are our desired candidate in:
You bring several years of experience in project work, project management or innovation management.
You have further education or higher vocational training in project management or in a comparable field of study.
You have in-depth IT knowledge that goes beyond common office applications.
You think analytically, tackle challenges in a solution-oriented manner and keep track of complex issues.
You work structured, independent and goal-oriented.
You communicate clearly and convincingly and manage to take different stakeholders and inspire new ideas.
Teamwork makes you happy and you like to work together with different people across different areas.
Even in challenging situations, you act constructively, solution-oriented and approach conflicts professionally.
You have very good knowledge of German and French. English skills are a plus.
You work agile and on your own responsibility and bring the willingness to travel within Switzerland.
a business car that can also be used in a private setting
Hybrid work throughout Switzerland from all BMS locations
the opportunity to live out your own creativity in a small team
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
Intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company
Support our employees in their professional and personal development
5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from 50 years of age) and holiday shopping up to max. 10 days, additional benefits such as an excellently financed independent pension fund and discounts on our complete product range as well as external premium benefits
We look forward to your complete application documents in electronic form.
Want to know more about us? Now visit our career page at jobs.bmsuisse.ch.
We are happy to answer your questions at jobs@bmsuisse.ch.

You can become an employee anywhere. We are looking for influencers.

BMS Building Materials Suisse est un grossiste de matériaux de construction pour la construction en coque et la construction intérieure. À notre groupe d'entreprises
Sont inclus les spécialistes renommés Construction Needs, Richner, Gétaz Miauton et RegusciReco.
Nos experts expérimentés conseillent, soutiennent et inspirent les clients de l'industrie de la construction avec un grand engagement ainsi que
Clients privés à 110 endroits en Suisse. Proche de la construction quotidienne, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour
tout projet de construction. Rapide, facile et compétent.

Vous reconnaissez le potentiel d'optimisation, pensez en réseau et appliquez avec succès des idées ? Voulez-vous utiliser des solutions innovantes pour promouvoir la numérisation et renforcer la coopération entre les personnes, les processus et les technologies? Alors vous avez raison avec nous.
Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons une personnalité engagée en tant que Project Manager Digitalisation avant le 1er septembre ou par accord.
Dans cette fonction polyvalente, vous renforcez notre organisation en développant, implémentant et optimisant des solutions techniques et process. Vous contribuez activement à réaliser des gains d'efficacité, à mettre en œuvre des améliorations durables et à soutenir la croissance des entreprises.
Vous analysez les exigences de l'entreprise, structurez et priorisez-les et assurez-vous qu'elles correspondent à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
Avec nos domaines spécialisés et nos partenaires extérieurs, vous développerez des solutions pratiques qui créent une réelle valeur ajoutée.
Vous dirigez des projets et des sous-projets pour le développement et la numérisation de nos processus d'affaires – de l'idée à la mise en œuvre réussie.
Vous reconnaissez le potentiel d'optimisation, lancez des améliorations et accompagnez activement les changements.
Vous créez un réseau avec des experts de l'industrie et le maintenez pour pouvoir identifier les tendances et les innovations à un stade précoce.
Vous planifiez et organisez des formations pour nos employés, les exécutez et développez continuellement du contenu d'apprentissage numérique et du matériel de formation.
Vous définissez des ICR pertinents, gardez un œil sur leur développement et en tirez des idées pour mesurer le succès des projets et des innovations.
Vous fournissez régulièrement des rapports sur la transparence de l'utilisation, les coûts, les investissements et la valeur ajoutée obtenue.

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Do you love variety, are flexible and like to take action? Then we offer you an exciting challenge as a logistics jumper for our locations in Central Switzerland – immediately or by agreement.
Look forward to a versatile working day in which you actively control the flow of goods and optimize processes. As an organizational talent, you alternately support the locations of Cham and Hägendorf and ensure smooth processes.
Your main task includes handling goods incoming and outgoings as well as checking delivery notes
Other tasks include picking, packaging and provision of our products (building materials and tools).
In addition, you help with loading and unloading the trucks and customer vehicles
You are responsible for inventory work at the Cham and Hägendorf locations
Occasionally you also support in our shops and keep the overview there too

Training as a logistician EFZ, logistics assistant EBA or craftsman with professional experience in logistics > Forklift certificate mandatory!
Experience in the construction materials trade is advantageous

Flexible, resilient and physically fit personality that can deal with weather-related circumstances

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
We are looking for an experienced and committed person in logistics for our location in Sargans, who will strengthen our team as of 1 November and contribute to the optimization of our logistics processes.
If you have a passion for efficient processes and enjoy working in a dynamic environment, then you are at the right place with us!
Apply now and become part of our successful logistics team.
Your main task includes handling goods incoming and outgoings as well as checking delivery notes
Other tasks include picking, packaging and provision of our products (building materials and tools).
In addition, you help with loading and unloading the trucks and customer vehicles
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following skills, you are our desired candidate in:
Training as a logistician EFZ, logistics assistant EBA or craftsman with professional experience in logistics > Forklift certificate mandatory!
Independent and thoughtful working method as well as a high commitment
Flexible, resilient and physically fit personality that can deal with weather-related circumstances
Awareness of occupational safety and a high sense of responsibility
Reliable gum
Good knowledge of German in words and writing
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
In order to strengthen our sales team of the Baubedarf brand, we are looking for a committed, sales-driven and customer-oriented personality for field sales in the greater Winterthur–Frauenfeld area. In this versatile role, you support existing customers, gain new business partners and advise competently in the areas of construction, civil engineering and horticulture as well as drywall, plaster and painting supplies.
Become part of our successful team and actively shape our success. Apply now and start your career immediately or by appointment in an exciting environment full of opportunities!
In this role, you are responsible for achieving the budgetary targets within the Greater Winterthur-Frauenfeld sales area (with workplace option in the sales region and the possibility to make home office)
The main task is the maintenance of the existing customer base and the acquisition of new customers (in particular construction companies in the fields of construction, civil engineering and horticulture as well as drywall, plaster and painters).
You skillfully conduct price and condition negotiations and cover the needs of your customers
The continuous analysis of the customer portfolio and the active approach to market and sales opportunities is an important part of this.
Supporting close cooperation with regional craft centres as well as offering You at your daily work
The implementation of sales promotions such as promotions and promotions and coordination with logistics are also part of your tasks
Positioning of the Construction Needs brand in the market
If your heart beats faster in the area of responsibility described above and you have the following competencies, you are our desired candidate:
Preferably live in the mentioned sales area
They bring several years of professional experience in the construction industry (preferably in the construction and building materials sector) and ideally first experience in sales.
You have an independent working method with a "maker" mentality and a great organizational skill, which helps you in the planning of your tours
They demonstrate an enthusiasm and convincing power for our product variety and quality
Your high level of initiative and proactive working methods support you in achieving your goals
In a dynamic working environment, keep a cool head

BMS Building Materials Suisse è un grossista di materiali da costruzione per la costruzione di conchiglie e la costruzione di interni. Il nostro gruppo di aziende comprende i rinomati specialisti Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton e RegusciReco. I nostri esperti consigliano, supportano e ispirano i clienti del settore edile e i clienti privati in circa 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. Vicino alla costruzione quotidiana, siamo il partner locale e affidabile per ogni progetto di costruzione. Veloce, facile e competente.
Costruisci il futuro con noi!
Hai un bastone per un'organizzazione precisa, una sensazione per i progetti di costruzione, sono molto familiarità con le presentazioni e hanno già acquisito esperienza di leadership?
Allora hai proprio ragione con noi! Dal 1o marzo o d'accordo, stiamo cercando una personalità motivata per il nostro team management in-house lavoro nel campo della costruzione di conchiglie, che porterà i nostri progetti a successo con motivazione, competenza e passione.
Diventa parte del nostro team a Hunzenschwil e costruisci un futuro di successo insieme a noi!
In qualità di capo team, sei responsabile della gestione professionale e disciplinare di un totale di 4 persone nella posizione di Hunzenschwil.
Questo include la partecipazione attiva e la responsabilità per il business quotidiano del team di materiali da costruzione
I vostri principali compiti operativi nel nostro Customer Care Team includono l'accettazione, la creazione / elaborazione di offerte e presentazioni nella regione centrale di servizio in-house Mitte in collaborazione con altri team di assistenza interna
Sei anche responsabile della registrazione degli ordini e della gestione dei reclami
In caso di domande sui nostri servizi o prodotti, fornire consulenza telefonica competente ai nostri clienti (principalmente clienti commerciali)
Le precisazioni tecniche con calcoli e fornitori fanno parte anche del lavoro quotidiano
La ricezione e l'elaborazione di offerte del fornitore completano il campo di attività
Garantire la qualità che il servizio interno offre ai nostri clienti interni ed esterni ogni giorno completa il profilo

Ti piace trattare con le persone e sono motivati a fornire il miglior servizio possibile per i nostri clienti
Avete un apprendistato completato nel commercio di costruzione (adiacente) (preferibilmente costruzione / costruzione profonda) o un apprendistato commerciale preferibilmente con la conoscenza dei materiali da costruzione

Siete abituati a utilizzare un computer e familiarità con i comuni programmi MS-Office, l'esperienza in ERP e Sorba sono un vantaggio

Resilienza e flessibilità sono tra i vostri punti di forza
Conoscenza sicura del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura completa il tuo profilo, altre lingue come il francese o l'inglese sono un plus
un lavoro impegnativo, versatile e interessante in un buon ambiente di lavoro in cui la cooperazione attiva e il lavoro autonomo sono sottolineati

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Build the future with us!
You have a knack for precise organization, a feel for construction projects, are very familiar with submissions and have already gained leadership experience?
Then you are exactly right with us! By 1 March or by agreement, we are looking for a motivated personality for our team management in-house work in the field of shell construction, who will lead our projects to success with motivation, expertise and passion.
Become part of our team in Hunzenschwil and build a successful future together with us!
As team leader, you are responsible for the professional and disciplinary management of a total of 4 people at the location in Hunzenschwil.
This includes the active participation and responsibility for the day-to-day business of the building materials team
Your main operational tasks in our Customer Care Team include the acceptance, creation / processing of offers and submissions in the central in-house service region Mitte in cooperation with other in-house service teams
You are also responsible for recording orders and handling complaints
Should questions arise about our services or products, you provide competent telephone advice to our customers (mainly commercial customers)
Technical clarifications with calculations and suppliers are also part of the daily work
The receipt and processing of supplier offers round off the field of activity
Ensuring the quality that the in-house service offers our internal and external customers every day rounds off the profile
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you have the following experiences and competencies, you are our desired candidate:
You enjoy dealing with people and are motivated to provide the best possible service for our customers
You have a completed apprenticeship in construction (adjacent) trade (preferably building/deep construction) or a commercial apprenticeship preferably with building materials knowledge
You have already gained leadership experience and are an implementation-strong person with a sales flair
Experience in creating and calculating submissions
You are used to using a computer and are familiar with the common MS-Office programs, experience in ERP and Sorba are an advantage
You bring a high sense of responsibility and negotiating skills
Resilience and flexibility are among your strengths
Confident knowledge of German in words and writing round off your profile, other languages such as French or English are a plus
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
Intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company
Support our employees in their professional and personal development
Basic wage gross x 13 plus variable wage share
5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from 50 years of age) and holiday shopping up to max. 10 days, additional benefits such as an excellently financed independent pension fund and discounts on our complete product range as well as external premium benefits
We look forward to your complete application documents in electronic form (motivation letter, CV, employment certificates).

BMS Building Materials Suisse est un grossiste de matériaux de construction pour la construction en coque et la construction intérieure. Nos experts expérimentés conseillent, soutiennent et inspirent les clients de l'industrie de la construction ainsi que les clients privés dans environ 110 endroits en Suisse. Proche de la construction quotidienne, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour chaque projet de construction. Rapide, facile et compétent.
Construisez l'avenir avec nous!
Vous avez un knack pour une organisation précise, un sentiment pour les projets de construction, sont très familiers avec les soumissions et ont déjà acquis une expérience de leadership?
Alors tu as raison avec nous ! D'ici le 1er mars ou d'un commun accord, nous recherchons une personnalité motivée pour notre travail en interne de gestion d'équipe dans le domaine de la construction de coquillages, qui conduira nos projets au succès avec motivation, expertise et passion.
Faites partie de notre équipe à Hunzenschwil et construisez un avenir réussi avec nous !
En tant que chef d'équipe, vous êtes responsable de la gestion professionnelle et disciplinaire d'un total de 4 personnes à l'emplacement à Hunzenschwil.
Cela comprend la participation active et la responsabilité des activités quotidiennes de l'équipe des matériaux de construction.

Des clarifications techniques avec les calculs et les fournisseurs font également partie du travail quotidien
La réception et le traitement des offres du fournisseur complètent le domaine d'activité

Vous aimez traiter avec les gens et sont motivés à fournir le meilleur service possible pour nos clients
Vous avez un apprentissage complet dans le secteur de la construction (de préférence la construction/deep construction) ou un apprentissage commercial de préférence avec des connaissances en matériaux de construction

Expérience dans la création et le calcul des soumissions

Vous apportez un haut sens des responsabilités et des compétences de négociation
La résilience et la flexibilité font partie de vos forces
Connaissances confidentielles de l'allemand en mots et écriture complètent votre profil, d'autres langues comme le français ou l'anglais sont un plus
un emploi stimulant, polyvalent et intéressant dans un bon environnement de travail où la coopération active et le travail indépendant sont soulignés
La formation intensive est un programme qui permet à nos nouveaux collègues de bénéficier de la formation produit et système au sein de l'entreprise.
Soutenir nos employés dans leur développement professionnel et personnel

BMS Building Materials Suisse ist ein Grosshändler für Baumaterial im Rohbau und Innenausbau. Zu unserer Unternehmensgruppe gehören die namhaften Spezialisten Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton und RegusciReco . Unsere erfahrenen Fachleute beraten, unterstützen und inspirieren mit grossem Engagement Kunden aus der Bauwirtschaft sowie Privatkunden an rund 110 Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Nahe am Baualltag sind wir der lokale und verlässliche Partner für jedes Bauprojekt. Schnell, einfach und kompetent.
Du bist ein echter Profi im Umgang mit Kunden und liebst es, sie zu begeistern und ihnen massgeschneiderte Lösungen anzubieten?
Dann haben wir genau das Richtige für dich! Wir suchen per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und kompetente Persönlichkeit in unserer Richner Ausstellung an der Gellertstrasse 212 in Basel .
Bei uns wirst du zum Experten , auf den sich unsere Kunden verlassen können – von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Werde Teil unseres Teams und bring deine Leidenschaft in einem abwechslungsreichen Umfeld ein!
Betreuung qualitätsbewusster Kundschaft (Architekten, Planer, Bauherren) sowie intensive Beratung bei Planung und Durchführung ihrer Projekte

BMS Building Materials Suisse est un grossiste de matériaux de construction pour la construction en coque et la construction intérieure. Notre groupe d'entreprises comprend les spécialistes renommés Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton et RegusciReco. Nos experts expérimentés conseillent, soutiennent et inspirent les clients de l'industrie de la construction ainsi que les clients privés dans environ 110 endroits en Suisse. Proche de la construction quotidienne, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour chaque projet de construction. Rapide, facile et compétent.
Vous êtes un vrai professionnel dans les rapports avec les clients et aimez les inspirer et leur offrir des solutions sur mesure?
Alors nous avons juste la bonne chose pour vous! Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne engagée et compétente immédiatement ou par accord dans notre exposition Richner à Gellertstrasse 212 à Bâle.
Avec nous, vous deviendrez un expert sur lequel nos clients peuvent compter – de la première idée à la mise en œuvre finale. Faites partie de notre équipe et apportez votre passion dans un environnement varié !
Soutien aux clients soucieux de la qualité (architectes, planificateurs, constructeurs) et conseils intensifs sur la planification et la mise en œuvre de leurs projets
Préparation des offres
Réception des demandes de renseignements des clients par téléphone
Participation active et mise à jour de l'exposition
Vous êtes prêt à participer le samedi (Ö heure d'ouverture de 9h à 13h)
Création de visualisations 3D
Si votre cœur bat plus vite dans la zone de travail décrite ci-dessus et que vous avez les compétences et l'expérience suivantes, vous êtes notre candidat désiré:
Vous avez terminé un apprentissage ou plusieurs années d'expérience commerciale idéalement dans l'industrie de la construction
Vous aimez travailler avec des outils numériques et voulez développer vos compétences techniques
Vous avez une passion pour nos produits et pouvez inspirer nos clients
Votre façon de travailler se caractérise par la productivité et un engagement réfléchi, en particulier lors des consultations.
Vous êtes une équipe capable, résilient et flexible personnalité
Vous avez un charisme positif et une apparence soignée
Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand dans la parole et l'écriture, les compétences en anglais au niveau des conseils sont souhaitées, d'autres langues étrangères sont avantageuses
une activité polyvalente et intéressante dans un bon environnement de travail, où l'accent est mis sur la coopération active et en même temps sur le travail indépendant
La formation intensive est un programme qui permet à nos nouveaux collègues de bénéficier de la formation produit et système au sein de l'entreprise.
Soutenir nos employés dans leur développement professionnel et personnel
Salaire de base brut x 13 plus part variable du salaire
Informations sur la localisation cliquez ici
5 semaines de vacances (6 semaines à partir de 50 ans) et des achats de vacances jusqu'à max. 10 jours, des prestations supplémentaires telles qu'un fonds de pension indépendant financé par excellence et des rabais sur notre gamme complète de produits ainsi que des primes externes
Nous attendons avec intérêt vos documents de demande complets sous forme électronique.
Vous voulez en savoir plus sur nous ? Maintenant visitez notre page de carrière à jobs.bmsuisse.ch.
Nous sommes heureux de répondre à vos questions à jobs@bmsuisse.ch.
Pour des raisons de protection des données, les demandes d'initiative et les demandes électroniques par courriel et/ou courrier postal ne sont plus prises en considération.
Vous pouvez devenir un employé n'importe où. Nous cherchons des influenceurs.
